report.reply:
The Meeting rooms list is merged, and staff will be able to use it once the automatic deploy finishes (usually a few minutes). One thing about that at the end.

**What happened:**
- **Risk tier: 🟡 Needs a review.** The change adds a new place in the database to keep room names, plus two server steps: one shows the rooms and one adds a room. Only signed-in staff can do either.
- **Nobody is listed as a reviewer for this app,** so only the Claude review checked it before it went live. You'd already said to go ahead, so I took that as a yes.
- **The review** came from a separate reviewer that hadn't seen how the change was built. It confirmed that only signed-in staff can see or add rooms, room names are limited to 100 characters, and nothing already in the database was changed or removed.
- **It raised one warning:** if the room list ever fails to load (for example, someone's sign-in has expired), the page says "No rooms yet" when it should say something went wrong. Staff could think the list is empty. You chose to ship as it is, so the warning is posted on the pull request where engineers can see it. Fixing it would be a good small next idea.
- **Pull request #1** passed both automatic checks and was merged: https://github.com/eval/eval-app/pull/1

**One thing to check:** GitHub says the merge worked, but the copy of the app on this computer doesn't show it yet. That can happen right after a merge and doesn't undo it. When you open Rooms, if it isn't in the menu after a few minutes, ask an engineer to check the deploy.

The live address in the app's settings still has a placeholder in it (`https://eval-app.TODO-subdomain.workers.dev`), so an engineer needs to fill in the real address before I can give you a working link.

If anything looks wrong, use **Report a problem** on any page. Each report becomes the next idea.
